name: badge
title: Badge
description: Small status label: accent, ok, warn, danger, and muted outline variants.

variants.name: accent
variants.description: Neutral-highlight state such as in review or open work.

variants.name: warn
variants.description: Attention state such as due soon.

variants.name: muted
variants.description: Muted outline for closed or archived; the only outlined variant.

props.name: variant
props.description: Visual variant; the closed data-uifa-variant table.

docs: A plain span with `data-uifa-variant`; no role so it reads as text in the accessibility tree. Keep the copy to one or two words. Pairs with the `status` roles `--uifa-ok`, `--uifa-warn`, `--uifa-danger` from the theme tokens.
